name: Trust Strip
description: A compact proof row for security, shipping, warranties, or social proof.

accessibility.semantics: Use native semantic elements in Trust Strip templates before ARIA.
accessibility.keyboard: No keyboard behavior required unless interactive content is slotted.
accessibility.focus: Inherits global focus styles for slotted links or controls.
notes: Color is never the only communication channel.
Motion must respect prefers-reduced-motion where animation exists.

responsive.strategy: Intrinsic layout with logical properties, responsive grids, and container queries where useful.

examples.name: Default
examples.notes: Use semantic landmarks and tokenized styling.
